item.title: Cleanup ongoing after 20K gallons of diesel spill in Spartanburg creek
item.description: Cleanup efforts are underway after an estimated 20,000 gallons of diesel fuel spilled into a Spartanburg creek, prompting environmental concerns and questions about how the incident happened.

item.title: Criminal investigation ongoing after Hendersonville police officer fired
item.description: An officer with the Hendersonville Police Department was fired after an investigation determined he was found to be falsely clocking in for an off-duty job for years.

item.description: GREENVILLE, S.C.
